answer.reason: The verses tell of Israel's defeat at Ai and its later capture and burning.

clauses.english: drove back Israel's first attack, killing about thirty-six men
clauses.quote: they fled before the men of Ai

clauses.english: was taken by Joshua in an ambush and burnt into a heap
clauses.quote: Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever

doubts: GEN 12:8 and GEN 13:3 only place Abram's tent near Hai (Ai) and were left out as location rather than event.
The Ezra and Nehemiah verses only list the men of Bethel and Ai and were not used.
